briefdescription.para: Execute multi-shard exact consistency query with deterministic fallback.

detaileddescription.para: Execute Multi Shard Exact Consistency.
Executes a query across multiple shards with exact consistency guarantees. If some shards fail, falls back to healthy shards while maintaining consistency.

Guarantees:
Quorum-based validation (majority of shards must agree)
Deterministic fallback to remaining healthy shards
Version token tracking for consistency verification

query
Query text.
shard_ids
Target shard identifiers.
Per-shard execution records; check validateMultiShardExactConsistency().
query
Input parameter.
shard_ids
Input parameter.
Return value.
Calls: empty(), size(), std::chrono::steady_clock::now(), push_back(), std::async(), executeLocal(), executeQuery(), std::string().

briefdescription.para: Validate multi-shard results for exact consistency.

detaileddescription.para: Validate Multi Shard Exact Consistency.
Checks that results from multiple shards are consistent and can be safely merged for exact consistency reads.

Validation criteria:
Quorum of shards must have succeeded
Version tokens must be within expected consistency window
No causal ordering violations

results
Vector of shard results.
true if results pass exact consistency validation, false otherwise.
results
Input parameter.
True when the operation succeeds.
Calls: empty(), push_back(), std::max(), size().

briefdescription.para: Routes point operations and queries to the appropriate shard set.
